raw:
Daniil Kvyat finished second or third once in 2015, at the Hungarian Grand Prix, where he was second behind Sebastian Vettel.

I checked the top-10 results for all 19 races in the 2015 season. Kvyat appears in the top 10 in 12 of them (Malaysia, Bahrain, Spain, Monaco, Canada, Britain, Hungary, Belgium, Italy, Singapore, Russia, Mexico, Brazil, Abu Dhabi), but only Hungary put him in second or third. In the other races he finished 4th to 10th, and he is absent from the top 10 in Australia, China, Austria, Japan and the United States. The search returned no 2015 standings document, so I did not use one.

ANSWER: 1
